localised_description: Wights flock to the strongest of their kind, just as they did in life.
Though flesh rots, and consciousness fades, a dead warrior's bones do not forget the weight of his axe.
A simple sword blow has little chance of stopping the unnatural resilience of the Undead.
An old servant of Khorne remembers the taste of his bloodlust.
Only the most resilient champions can be tasked with waging eternal war.
